title: a11y focus: SmartSetWindowOrder + full tier chain (v6.8+)
desc: WKAppBot complete OS-level focus service spec. SmartSetWindowOrder is the single focusless Z-order primitive — called before all interactive write actions and focus commands. Zero keyboard-focus steal from user at all times.
steps: SMART WINDOW ORDER -- SmartSetWindowOrder(hwnd) [A11yCommand.WindowActions.cs]: the single focusless Z-order primitive, never steals keyboard focus. 6 steps: (1) GetParent chain walk to root ancestor; (2) iconic root -> ShowWindow(SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE); (3) MDI/child window -> BringWindowToTop(hwnd); (4) PlaceRootBehindForeground: strip WS_EX_TOPMOST, SetWindowPos(insertAfter=fg, SWP_NOACTIVATE) -> rank 2; (5) owner chain via GW_OWNER up to 8 levels, same treatment; (6) target ends at Z-order rank 2 behind the user active window, focus never transferred
WINDOW-LEVEL FOCUS -- A11yFocus(hwnd, tag): IsIconic -> SW_RESTORE, then SmartSetWindowOrder (full 6-step service)

ELEMENT-LEVEL FOCUS -- A11yFocusElement(el, hwnd) [A11yActions.Focus.cs]: 5-tier cascade -- Tier -1 PRE (FindRootWindow + SmartSetWindowOrder), Tier 0 CDP (TryCdpFocus, Chrome only), Tier 1 UIA (el.Focus()), Tier 2 Win32 (SetFocus on element hwnd), Tier 3 Win32 root fallback

WRITE ACTION PRE-FOCUS -- SmartSetWindowOrder(hwnd) runs BEFORE 10 interactive write actions (invoke, click, type, set-value, set-range, toggle, expand, collapse, select, scroll). EXCLUDED: read/find/inspect/screenshot/ocr/windows (read-only), close/minimize/maximize/restore (own Z-order needs), highlight/focus (own handling)

ZERO-STEAL RULES (absolute, no exceptions): FORBIDDEN -- SetForegroundWindow, SetActiveWindow, AttachThreadInput (all steal keyboard focus). ALLOWED Z-order -- SetWindowPos(SWP_NOACTIVATE), BringWindowToTop (child only), ShowWindow(SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE). ALLOWED keyboard focus -- UIA el.Focus(), Win32 SetFocus(elementHwnd) (set focus on a specific control without changing foreground window)

SOURCE FILES: A11yCommand.WindowActions.cs (SmartSetWindowOrder, A11yFocus, overlay guard), A11yActions.Focus.cs (A11yFocusElement, tier cascade), A11yCommand.cs:1907 (write-action pre-focus injection)
